invariant_candidates: Normalized oracle values remain within documented unit and decimal assumptions.
manual_review_notes: Review whether feed decimals are fixed at deployment.
safety_notes: Use synthetic feed answers and local mocks.

Test zero, negative, or invalid oracle answers if applicable.
Assert normalized price units match accounting units.
Document and test oracle freshness, decimals normalization, price bounds, and fallback behavior.

invariant_candidates: Accounting decisions only use oracle data that satisfies documented freshness policy.
manual_review_notes: Check whether freshness validation is implemented in an imported adapter.
safety_notes: Use local mock oracle responses only.
findings.source_report_evidence_summary: src/ToyLendingMarket.sol in `getPrice`: Solidity function contains oracle or price-feed call evidence.
suggested_tests: Reject stale oracle rounds or document fallback behavior.
Test updatedAt or heartbeat boundaries.
Test borrow, liquidation, vault, or reward flows when oracle data is stale.
Use a local mock price feed to assert stale or incomplete oracle rounds are rejected or handled according to documented policy.
findings.title: Oracle-dependent logic without stale-price tests

invariant_candidates: Borrowing and liquidation decisions only use oracle data that satisfies documented validity policy.
manual_review_notes: Review fallback behavior and collateral-specific feed assumptions.
safety_notes: Use local oracle values and synthetic price shocks.
findings.source_report_evidence_summary: src/ToyLendingMarket.sol in `getPrice`: Solidity function contains oracle or price-feed call evidence.
suggested_tests: Test stale oracle rejection for borrow and liquidation paths.
Test decimals normalization for collateral valuation.
Test price shock boundaries around health-factor transitions.
Mock stale, invalid, and sharply moved prices and assert borrow/liquidation behavior follows documented policy.
findings.title: Oracle-dependent borrowing/liquidation without stale-price tests

invariant_candidates: Invalid or out-of-bound price inputs cannot silently drive critical accounting decisions.
manual_review_notes: Review whether fallback behavior is intentionally unavailable.
findings.source_report_evidence_summary: src/ToyLendingMarket.sol in `getPrice`: Solidity function contains oracle or price-feed call evidence.
suggested_tests: Test documented price bounds.
Test invalid answer fallback behavior.
Add documentation for price shock and fallback assumptions.

invariant_candidates: Unauthorized users cannot mutate privileged configuration.
manual_review_notes: Review role inheritance and deployment ownership transfer.
findings.source_report_evidence_summary: src/ToyLendingMarket.sol in `setGuardian`: Solidity function contains access-control or lifecycle modifier evidence.
suggested_tests: Test unauthorized callers cannot change critical parameters.
Test authorized role can perform expected setter actions.
Document role ownership and transfer procedure.
For every privileged function, assert an unprivileged caller reverts and the documented role succeeds only within intended bounds.
findings.title: Privileged setters without role-boundary tests

invariant_candidates: Collateral value and debt remain inside documented solvency constraints after allowed user actions.
manual_review_notes: Review collateral factor and price-unit assumptions.
safety_notes: Use local price and balance mocks only.
findings.source_report_evidence_summary: src/ToyLendingMarket.sol in `depositCollateral`: Solidity function contains external value-flow call evidence.
suggested_tests: Assert solvent positions remain solvent after deposit, borrow, repay, and withdraw flows.
Test debt cannot exceed documented collateral constraints.
Test unsafe withdrawals are rejected or explicitly documented.
Assert debt cannot exceed documented collateral constraints and collateral withdrawals cannot make a position unsafe unless intended and tested.
findings.title: Collateral/debt solvency invariant not covered by tests

invariant_candidates: Liquidation eligibility changes only at documented threshold boundaries.
manual_review_notes: Review rounding around exact threshold values.
safety_notes: Use local threshold setup and synthetic accounts.
findings.source_report_evidence_summary: src/ToyLendingMarket.sol in `depositCollateral`: Solidity function contains external value-flow call evidence.
suggested_tests: Test just-above-threshold positions cannot be liquidated.
Test just-below-threshold positions can be liquidated according to policy.
Assert liquidation bonus and close factor stay within documented bounds.
Test a position just above threshold cannot be liquidated and a position just below threshold can be liquidated within documented bonus bounds.
findings.title: Liquidation boundary tests missing

invariant_candidates: Interest and borrow indexes move according to documented rate policy and do not drift unexpectedly.
manual_review_notes: Review whether index math is inherited from a shared library.
safety_notes: Use local time-step helpers or explicit accrual calls.
findings.source_report_evidence_summary: src/ToyLendingMarket.sol in `depositCollateral`: Solidity function contains external value-flow call evidence.
suggested_tests: Test interest or borrow index monotonicity.
Cover small balances and repeated accrual.
Test borrow and repay before and after accrual.
Advance local time across multiple accrual steps and assert borrow indexes and balances remain monotonic and bounded by documented rounding.
findings.title: Interest/index accounting not covered by rounding and time-step tests

invariant_candidates: Cash, total borrows, total reserves, and utilization remain internally consistent.
manual_review_notes: Review reserve factor and protocol fee accounting.
safety_notes: Use local asset mocks and synthetic liquidity.
findings.source_report_evidence_summary: src/ToyLendingMarket.sol in `depositCollateral`: Solidity function contains external value-flow call evidence.
suggested_tests: Test borrow cannot exceed available liquidity.
Test repay updates cash, debt, and reserves consistently.
Assert reserves cannot be withdrawn beyond documented constraints.
Assert borrow reverts above available liquidity and repay updates cash, debt, reserves, and utilization consistently.
findings.title: Reserve/cash accounting assumptions not covered
